about_short_description.short_description: LifestyleRX delivers insurance-covered virtual care for Type 2 Diabetes reversal.

product.name: 12-Week Type 2 Diabetes Reversal Program
product.description: A virtual, physician-led program teaching sustainable lifestyle changes to reverse Type 2 Diabetes, including weekly group sessions, physician consultations, and educational materials.

product.name: 12-Week Excess Weight Management Program
product.description: A virtual, physician-led program addressing obesity and metabolic health through lifestyle changes, including group sessions, physician visits, and educational content.

product.name: 1:1 Virtual Dietitian Sessions
product.description: Personalized virtual consultations with registered dietitians to support nutrition planning and lifestyle changes for diabetes reversal and metabolic health.

product.name: Personal Health Reports
product.description: Reports that analyze lab results and health markers to inform patients about their current health status and progress in diabetes reversal.
